color-contrast.title: Text elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
color-contrast.summary: Ensure text has sufficient contrast against its background (at least 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text).

link-name.title: Links must have discernible, accessible text
link-name.summary: Every link must have an accessible name that clearly communicates the destination or purpose of the link.

image-alt.title: Images must have text alternatives
image-alt.summary: Informative images need descriptive alt attributes. Decorative images should have empty alt="" attributes.

button-name.title: Buttons must have discernible text
button-name.summary: Buttons must have clear accessible names describing the triggered action.

region.title: All page content must be contained by landmarks
region.summary: Wrap top-level page sections in HTML5 landmark elements (<header>, <nav>, <main>, <footer>, <aside>).

heading-order.title: Heading levels should only increase by one
heading-order.summary: Heading tags (<h1> to <h6>) must reflect the true structural hierarchy of the document without skipping levels.

html-has-lang.title: <html> element must have a valid lang attribute
html-has-lang.summary: Add a valid BCP 47 language code to the root <html> tag (e.g. <html lang="en">).

target-size.title: Pointer targets must meet minimum size requirements
target-size.summary: Ensure touch and click targets are at least 24x24 CSS pixels or have sufficient spacing offset.
